skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cleaning] — You wipe down the nearest surface out of old habit. It gleams.
skills.description: Cleans mundane messes with supernatural ease.
Steadier hands with any blade.
A frame hardened by work and worse.

skills.field_ambient: [Power Strike] — You set your feet, then ease off the swing. Nothing here wants cutting.
skills.description: Everything behind one blow.
The next blade that finds you meets an answer.
A felled foe quickens the blood.

skills._comment: GH#90 rider: `applies.burning` (2 dmg/round tick, 3 rounds) -- a fire bolt catching cloth/fur alight is the direct fictional read, no reach needed.
skills.description: A hissing dart of goblin fire.

skills._comment: `burns` ON (ruling 4) enrolls this combat spell in the burns x burnable row: it IS a universal debris-burner now, the cost the flag was withheld for. Carcass beat survives -- its authored requires_skill arm outranks the property table, so `burned_the_debris` never banks there.
skills.field_ambient: [Flame Jet] — Fire runs out of your palm, finds nothing worth burning, and dies in the air.
skills.description: A roaring lance of goblin-fire down the line.
A dart of biting cold that clings to the legs.
Woven mana drinks the blow before flesh does.
The first spell leaves the fingers before the thought finishes.

skills._comment: `toggles_light` puts [Light] on the same footing as the `sneaks` Skills: one flag, one arm, on/off with its own copy on each side. field_ambient is the ON line, field_ambient_off the OFF line; the placement trap lives at field_skills.gd's `toggles_light` arm.
skills.field_ambient: [Light] — A steady white orb rises to follow you, throwing back the dark.
skills.field_ambient_off: [Light] — You let the orb thin out. The dark closes back in, patient as ever.
skills.description: A mage's first, faithful spell: a small orb of steady white light.
The feet decide before the mind does.
Breath returns, and the body remembers it can go on.
A cold prickle at the neck, a heartbeat before harm.

skills.field_ambient: [Piercing Strikes] — You level the spear and hunt for the gap. There is nothing here to put a point through.
skills.description: Thrusts that seek the seams in any guard.
A cut loosed before the guard can rise.
One bright line. The eye catches up too late.
Mid-swing, the blade bends its path toward whatever is unguarded.
Three points of pain in a single breath.
A wide, raking arc that finds an opening no straight thrust could.
For one moment the air is stitched with spearpoints.
A fist-sized spike of ice, hurled hard enough to crack shields.

skills._comment: Renamed [Icy Floor] -> [Ice Floor], id UNCHANGED (save-compat). SECOND `freezes` carrier -- why both freezes REFUSAL rows read copy off the skill: a row line would name the wrong Skill.
skills.freeze_toast: [Ice Floor] — The spell wants a floor and takes the water instead. Grey ice spreads from the bank in one long crack, thick enough to stand on. It will not last past your next rest.
skills.field_ambient: [Ice Floor] — Frost sheets out across the ground and thins away to nothing. There is no standing water here for it to lock.
skills.frost_hearth_refusal: [Ice Floor] — Ice skids over the hot stone and is gone before it can settle. The fire goes on eating.
skills.frost_person_refusal: [Ice Floor] — The glaze starts under their boots and you stop it there. Putting someone on their back on ice is a thing you do to an enemy.
skills.description: The stones glaze over, and footing becomes a rumor. Still water takes it the same way, and holds.
An arm's-length arc of fire, reaped close.
A snap of light and heat that leaves spots dancing in the eyes.

skills._comment: Instant damage only -- no terrain write, no status write, no expiry seam (contrast icy_floor, which glazes+slows for `duration_rounds`).
skills.description: A ring of fire blooms at the target's feet, then erupts into a roaring pillar.
Mana runs down the blade until the edge sings.

skills._comment: Structurally unreachable by `sim_combat_batch.gd` (spellsword is never assigned in the harness's BUILDS array, same as fire_mage/ice_mage precedent) -- no balance-harness re-run needed.
skills.description: Every spell you have ever cast settles into the strike, and the strike remembers all of them at once.
Chores that would tire another barely slow you.

skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cooking] — You picture the dish this place is missing. Your hands twitch toward a ladle that isn't there.
skills.description: Simple meals come out right, every time.
skills._comment_cookware: GH#391: the generic `cookware` arm; a prop's own authored arm still wins.

cookware_use.toast: [Basic Cooking] — You get the pot hot, work with what is in it, and it comes out food.

skills.description: Trays, kegs, and crates feel lighter than they should.

skills._comment: Canon pass: renamed [Observe] -> [Appraise Foe] (id `observe` UNCHANGED -- save-compat; ids are never player-visible).
skills.field_ambient: [Appraise Foe] — You take in the empty space around you. Nothing here rewards a closer look.
skills.description: A measuring look that reads a room, a person, a problem, and files it away for later.
The whole field resolves into a map. You always know the one step that matters.

skills.field_ambient: [Soothe Clientele] — You offer the empty room a calming word. Only the dust settles.
skills.description: A word and a refilled glass, and the room's troubles ease. Patrons forget whatever was gnawing at them.

skills.field_ambient: [Unerring Aim] — You size up a throw out of habit. Nothing here is worth the toss.
skills.description: Whatever you throw finds its mark: a mug slid down the bar, a rag, or a troublemaker's head.

skills.field_ambient: [Sweep the Tables] — You reach to clear the dishes. The tables here are already bare.
skills.description: A cluttered table comes clean in a single pass, the dishes spirited back to the kitchen.

skills.field_ambient: [Server's Prescience] — You listen for what the room needs next. All quiet, for now.
skills.description: You know what a guest wants before they raise a hand: the empty cup, the missing fork, the order about to be called.

skills.field_ambient: [Charming Smile] — You flash a warm, easy smile at no one in particular. A passing sparrow seems charmed, at least.
skills.description: A warm, disarming smile that puts people at ease and turns a cold first meeting friendly.
A steadying word and a calming hand; the fight drains out of a foe, and their guard turns slow and uncertain.

skills._comment: raskghar_awakened's ONLY skill, so the AI (`_act_ranged`'s spell_id scan) always picks it -- guaranteed real, no dead-code risk, cast almost every turn it's in range.
skills.description: A sweeping, reaching swipe of claw and forearm that batters the legs out from under you and leaves them slow to answer.

skills._comment: Canon rename: [Frost Touch] -> [Snap Freeze] (id `frost_touch` UNCHANGED -- save-compat).
skills.freeze_toast: [Snap Freeze] — You lay your palm to the water and cold spiders out from it. In a breath the channel locks to grey-white ice, thick enough to bear your weight. It will not last past your next rest.
skills.field_ambient: [Snap Freeze] — Frost blooms from your fingers and hangs glittering in the air. There is nothing here for it to grip.
skills.description: A breath of deep cold that skins still water in load-bearing ice.

skills._comment: Canon rename: [Kindle] -> [Firefly] (id `kindle` UNCHANGED -- save-compat).
skills.field_ambient: [Firefly] — A curl of flame dances up over your knuckles and gutters out. Nothing here will take the fire.
skills.description: A conjured flame, hot enough to take dry debris and old timber in moments.

skills._comment: Canon rename (closes the provisional naming AND the real class grant): [Sneak] -> [Stealth] (id `sneak` UNCHANGED -- save-compat; ids are never player-visible, verified by grep -- no UI surface renders a raw id).
skills.description: A soft step that slips past watching eyes and clears ground when blades are drawn.

skills._comment: COEXISTENCE CONTRACT (unchanged): [Stealth] and [Invisibility] both flip the SAME single field `sneaking` bool -- one stance, two keys.
skills.description: A working that bends the light around you until even a careful eye finds nothing worth watching.

skills._comment: GH#94 icon drain: icon_power_shot added (code-drawn fletched-arrow glyph, tools/sync_assets.py::_draw_placeholder shape 'arrow_power').
skills.description: A full draw, held a breath too long, loosed dead center.

skills._comment: GH#70 [Archer].
skills.description: Nock, draw, loose — before the first arrow lands, the second is already gone.

skills._comment: Reuses line_damage VERBATIM (flame_jet's own effect type/resolver, WISkillEffects._resolve_line_damage) -- an arrow that overpenetrates instead of a jet of fire, weapon-gated to bow instead of element-gated.
skills.description: One arrow, and everything in its path pays the same price.

skills._comment: Deliberately NOT the same skill id as `observe` (a distinct grant, not a re-grant of Tactician's [Appraise Foe]) -- no combat effect, exploration-only, contexts/field/field_ambient shape copied from `observe` verbatim.
skills.field_ambient: [Keen Eye] — You read the room the way you'd read a stand of trees for game: what moved, what didn't, what's worth a second look. Nothing here needs tracking.
skills.description: A hunter's habit of noticing: the broken twig, the wrong shadow, the one thing that doesn't belong.

skills._comment: Enemy-only (vault_construct, data/combatants.json) -- no class grants it.
skills.description: A vast fist draws back, and the floor itself seems to brace.

skills._comment: Id `directed_strike` is PINNED (Lane B builds against it) and unchanged -- only display_name substitutes, the same id-stable/display-swap convention sneak->[Stealth]/observe->[Appraise Foe] already established.
skills.description: You read the opening before it's there, and the blow lands exactly where it was always going to.
A half-step that puts you exactly where the fight isn't looking.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- no wiki match found; mirrors [Battlefield Awareness]'s own unflagged precedent (Tactician's L1 grant, same idiom).
skills.description: The whole board resolves at once — every gap in a guard, every foot planted wrong.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked, no match.
skills.field_ambient: [Measured Words] — You turn a careful phrase to no one in particular. It lands, as it always does, on empty air.
skills.description: Every word chosen and weighed before it leaves the mouth — the kind of care that opens doors a blunt tongue never finds.

skills._comment: Costs MP unlike second_wind (a genuine resource tax distinguishing the two self/ally heals) and heals less (6 vs second_wind's 8) since it can reach a second body.
skills.description: A calm that isn't performed — it settles over the room, and over a hurting friend, the same way.

skills._comment: AP-only (no mp_cost, a construct's ward isn't a spell) -- a small mend plus a defensive ward is the direct read for an escort construct covering its hurt sibling/boss.
skills.description: A muttered ward and a steadying hand — the hurt eases, and the next blow lands a little softer.

skills.field_ambient: [Open Doors] — You offer the easy, practiced warmth that opens rooms. There is no room here to open.
skills.door_flavor: [Open Doors] — The door was not locked. It opens anyway, with tremendous ceremony, and somewhere the Skill feels appreciated.
skills.description: Doors that would stay shut for anyone else swing open at your approach — goodwill has its own kind of key.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect index), no match for a bare trap-sense Skill.
skills.field_ambient: [Find Trap] — You scan the ground and walls out of old habit. Nothing here is rigged.
skills.description: A practiced eye for the telltale signs of a trap: a loose stone, a taut wire, a floor that doesn't quite match.

skills._comment: Field-only, same requires_skill+on_skill_use seam, no new sim code.
skills.field_ambient: [Disarm Trap] — Your fingers twitch through the motions of a disarm. There is nothing here to still.
skills.description: Steady hands and a thief's patience: whatever waits to spring, waits a little longer.

skills._comment: Id `sudden_strike` is PINNED and unchanged -- only display_name substitutes.
skills.description: One chance, taken before the fight knows to expect it.

skills._comment: Id PINNED.
skills.description: A shot picked out in advance, and placed exactly there.

skills._comment: Id PINNED.
skills.description: A punishing volley loosed down the line, arrow after arrow finding the same seam.

skills._comment: flame_jet stays untouched (still the only line-shaped fire skill); this is the practical EARLY single-target active fire lacked entirely.
skills.description: A guttering mote of flame flung hard and fast, spent before it can gutter out.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect/P), no match for a bare hospitality-themed Skill.
skills.field_ambient: [Perfect Hospitality] — You straighten a chair, smooth a cloth, ready the room out of habit. There's no one here to welcome yet.
skills.description: Every guest finds exactly the welcome they didn't know they needed — a warm room, a full glass, a seat that was somehow already theirs.

skills._comment: `weapon: bow` gates it through the SAME `weapon_gated_kit` filter every other weapon-tagged skill already uses, so it only ever contributes with a bow equipped -- the 'bow passive' framing holds exactly.
skills.description: Breath out, string back, and the point of aim simply stops drifting — a drawn bow held as still as a nail in a beam.

skills._comment: Deliberately carries NEITHER `ap_cost`/`effect` NOR `field: true` -- a pure passive identity trait, the SAME shape lesser_stamina/lesser_strength already ship (flavor-only, never castable).
skills.description: An instinct for what a price is REALLY worth, and the nerve to say so out loud. Where haggling is welcome, the asking price comes down for you.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked, no match.
skills.field_ambient: [Appraise Goods] — You turn an imagined item over in your hands out of habit, weighing a price that isn't there.
skills.description: A trader's eye: where a thing came from, what it's really worth, and whether the asking price is honest.

skills._comment: No `ap_cost`/`effect`/`field` -- same passive-identity shape as bargain above.
skills.description: Wholesale eyes on a retail world — goods move through you in bulk, and the numbers favor the one who moves them.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- passive-identity shape matches bargain/lesser_stamina.
skills.description: The road is long. Your legs have stopped caring.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Fals, 7.00; passive-identity shape matches bargain/lesser_stamina.
skills.description: Every stride lands cleanly, wasting neither breath nor road.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki name carries an unresolved early-volume citation; battlefield_awareness's move_pool_bonus shape verbatim.
skills.description: The opening between one step and the next becomes a road of its own.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL -- noun-phrase replacement for the rejected imperative [Brew Remedy].
skills.field_ambient: [Hedge Remedy] — You stir an absent pot and sort imaginary roots. The working needs a real cauldron.
skills.description: Root, leaf, patience, and the exact moment the pot should leave the fire.

cookware_use.toast: [Hedge Remedy] — Any pot will do, if the hands mean it. The steam settles into something kinder.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL -- hp_bonus reuses tough_body's passive combat shape; witch kit stays AP-only.
skills.description: A quiet promise laid over skin and spirit: not this one, not yet.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL -- calming_touch's no-MP spell_damage shape, range 3, weakened rider; no element counter.
skills.description: One hard look catches like a curse, and certainty drains from the target's limbs.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Pisces' spell list; frost_bolt's costs and range without a rider.
skills.description: A splinter of white bone snaps into being and flies point-first.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Pisces; spell_damage reuses shipped range and weakened-rider seams.
skills.description: A black-green lance that leaves warmth and courage guttering behind it.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Pisces and Ceria, 2.15; field_ambient shape matches other prop-cast utility skills.
skills.field_ambient: [Detect Magic] — You open your senses. No nearby working answers.
skills.description: Magic leaves pressure, color, and intent behind. You have learned how to look.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Erin, 2.17; field_ambient shape matches basic_cooking with a distinct icon.
skills.field_ambient: [Advanced Cooking] — You compose a meal in your head. It needs a proper station: a chef's counter, or a stall burner.
skills.description: Cast at a chef's station to plate a fine meal — worth an extra 2 HP in your next fight. A kitchen becomes possibility: timing, balance, and the dish hidden inside the ingredients.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Erin, 2.17; passive-identity shape limited to recipes and practiced arts.
skills.description: Every recipe and practiced motion waits exactly where you left it.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- field prop-cast shape matches advanced_cooking.
skills.field_ambient: [Signature Dish] — The dish is already clear in your mind. Only the kitchen is missing.
skills.description: One dish bears your hand so completely that no other cook could make it the same.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED with AMBIGUOUS-lean-PASS flag -- accepted 2026-07-15 despite renumbering drift; steady_draw's hit_bonus amount reused.
skills.field_ambient: [Eagle Eyes] — Distance sharpens, but there is no vantage here worth claiming.
skills.description: Distance gives up its secrets: tracks, motion, and the one detail that does not belong.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- sudden_strike's once-per-fight numbers with a bow gate.
skills.description: You choose the quarry before drawing. The arrow only completes the decision.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Valceif, 2.15; combat half reuses move_pool_bonus verbatim.
skills.description: One stride becomes two, with the road between them briefly optional.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Pisces' Tier-3 spell. FIELD HALF MP-INFORMATIONAL, matching shipped [Invisibility]; combat spends the listed 3 MP. Combat half reuses move_pool_bonus verbatim.
skills.description: The first lesson is footwork. The second is leaving distance behind.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Pisces; field-only companion working at the three authored bone piles.
skills.description: Old bones remember just enough motion to answer a practiced command.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- one-sleep trigger-radius suppression.
skills.description: Thread, wax, and intent laid where danger means to cross.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- distinct two-sleep ward id; never re-semanticize hearthward_charm.
skills.description: A stronger charm remembers its boundary after one night has passed.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (6.39, Octavia). [Mixer] L1 field bench-cast: consumes nothing v1 (basic_cooking precedent), yields a low-tier consumable + banks synthesized_draught. field_ambient shape matches basic_cooking.
skills.field_ambient: [Low-Grade Synthesis] — You measure out a working in your head. It wants a real bench and a burner you don't have here.
skills.description: The first thing any mixer learns: crude reagents over a low flame, and a result that mostly behaves.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (6.39). Pure passive identity (actives-become-passives directive) -- botched mixtures burn off clean; no bench, no hotbar slot. Icon carried for the journal panel only.
skills.description: A botched mixture never festers. Heat takes the failure cleanly, and the bench is ready for the next attempt.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (6.39). [Mixer] L5 field bench-cast: yields solvent_phial (a component item) + banks synthesized_draught.
skills.field_ambient: [Magic-Water Solvent] — You think through the dilution, drop by drop. Without magic-water and a clean phial, it stays a thought.
skills.description: Magic-water, drawn down and clarified until it will lift what plain water cannot. The base every finer working starts from.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (6.39). [Mixer] L7 field bench-cast: yields mineral_salts (a component item) + banks synthesized_draught.
skills.field_ambient: [Mineral Distillation] — You picture the slow boil and the salts left behind. It needs a retort and a fire you don't have here.
skills.description: Boil a mineral wash down far enough and what remains is pure salts, the backbone of any potion worth the name.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible. [Alchemist] L10 field bench-cast: the first component-consuming recipe -- eats solvent_phial + mineral_salts (requires_item + remove_item String|Array seam, #155) and yields tonic_of_the_clear_eye + banks synthesized_draught.
skills.field_ambient: [True Synthesis] — You lay the whole working out in your mind, solvent into salts in the one order that holds. Only a proper bench will bear it.
skills.description: Where a mixer combines, an alchemist transforms. Solvent and salts, brought together in the right hand, become something neither one was.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (3.23 L). [Beast Tamer] L1 pure passive identity (actives-become-passives directive) -- no hotbar slot; icon carried for the journal panel only.
skills.description: Animals in your care simply do better. They eat, they mend, they trust. It is not magic, except in the way it is.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (4.21 E). Passive on the PLAYER record (no effect key -- the kit fold would buff the PC); the companion-side +hit lives in basic_command_boon, injected onto the companion combatant at roster build (wi_game.gd, GH#156).
skills.description: Sit. Stay. Strike. A trained beast hears the shape of your intent, not just the word.

skills.description: A trained beast fights like it has heard the plan.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED shape '[Lesser Bond: Name]' (3.11 E). Field tame: `tames: true` routes through the companion_source seam (wi_game.gd _animate_field) -- casts at tameable props carrying `companion_source`, refusal toast otherwise. Tamed companions PERSIST sleep.
skills.field_ambient: [Lesser Bond] — You reach out, and nothing here reaches back. The wild keeps its own company today.
skills.description: A thin thread of trust, offered and accepted. It is not ownership. Nothing about it is ownership.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, care-tier canon-plausible (flagged in spec). Field cast at wounded-beast props via the requires_skill/on_skill_use seam; banks tended_beasts.
skills.field_ambient: [Beast's Mending] — Your hands know what to do, but nothing hurt waits here to be helped.
skills.description: Splint, salve, and a steadiness that tells a frightened animal the worst is over.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (Mrsha pre-upgrade). Passive: beast-kind (`beast: true`) ambush encounters trigger at radius -1 for this player -- code seam at wi_game.gd _wild_affinity_reduction, AMBUSH CHECK ONLY. [Peace of the Wild] supersedes at -2.
skills.description: Wild things startle later around you, and settle sooner. You smell like something that belongs.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL (companion max-hp step). Passive on the PLAYER record; the companion-side +hp lives in pack_bond_boon, injected at roster build (GH#156).
skills.description: The bond runs both ways now. What follows you is harder to kill, because it knows you are coming back for it.

skills._comment: COMPANION BOON (GH#156): hidden effect-carrier for [Pack Bond] -- never granted to a class; appended to the COMPANION combatant at roster inject.
skills.description: Harder to kill, because it knows you are coming back for it.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (5.06 M) -- the [Wild Affinity] upgrade. Same code seam (wi_game.gd _wild_affinity_reduction), reduction 2, supersedes.
skills.description: The wild has decided about you. Wolves note you and go back to their business; even the small things stop holding their breath.

skills.description: You feel the room tilt toward trouble a breath before it does: a dropped tray, a raised fist, a blade under a coat.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL (collision adjudication) -- [Server's Prescience] went to the barmaid sibling, so the hustle voice ships instead. Server L14, move_pool +1 turn-start passive.
skills.description: Every step between the tables is already planned, so your feet never waste one.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED. Merchant L14 field value-read -- field_ambient identity (appraise_goods shape), no combat effect.
skills.field_ambient: [Evaluation of Wealth] — You weigh the room for what it is worth. Nothing here carries a price worth naming today.
skills.description: A glance tells you the true worth of a thing: what it cost, what it will fetch, and what the seller hopes you do not notice.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (4.24, 4.44 M). Courier L14. Ships as couriers_double_step because shipped [Runner] L5 [Double Step] owns `double_step`; passive move_pool +2 (distinct from the inherited active).
skills.description: The road learns your name. Two strides for every one, and it never seems to tire you.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED. Witch L14 omen-read -- dangersense passive, the hedge-craft foresight.
skills.description: The leaves settle into shapes, and the shapes are always about what is coming. Usually it is bad. Usually you are ready.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED [Supplies:]. Chef L14. Restocks one flarepepper_powder at each rest via the sleep() hook (wi_game.gd, known_skills gate, never stacks); passive identity record.
skills.description: Your pack is never quite empty. There is always one more twist of flarepepper put by, ready for the pan.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED (6.39, Xif). Alchemist L14 field bench-cast (true_synthesis shape) -- reduces crude_draught into tonic_of_the_clear_eye. Recipe rides an alchemy bench's on_skill_use; no bench wired this wave (field_ambient identity until one is placed).
skills.field_ambient: [Perfect Reduction] — You lay out the reduction in your head, crude draught to clear tonic. It wants a proper bench you do not have here.
skills.description: Where a lesser hand throws out the crude batch, you boil it down to its one true part: nothing wasted, nothing left but the working itself.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL (collision adjudication -- research's [Lesser Bond] is ATTESTED 6.08 but the id is the shipped [Beast Tamer] tame verb). Beast Master L14. Passive on the PLAYER record (no effect -- the kit fold would buff the PC unconditionally); the +hit lives in sworn_fang_boon, injected PC-side at roster build while a companion rides (GH#156 pattern inverted).
skills.description: You and the beast beneath you think as one animal now. Where it turns, you strike; where you lean, it carries you.

skills._comment: COMPANION BOON (GH#165, inverse of GH#156): hidden PC-side carrier for [Sworn Fang: Ride Together] -- never granted to a class, never hotbar-bound; appended to the PC combatant at roster build while a companion rides. hit_bonus reuses the basic_command_boon tuned value.
skills.description: Two bodies, one certainty. The strike lands because both of you already knew it would.

skills._comment: PASSIVE: no `field`, no hotbar slot. wi_game.gd's _even_footing_crosses pins THIS id; exemption is bound to `unsteady` alone, never `freezable`.
skills.description: Loose stone and wet plank hold under you where they would drop anyone else.

skills.field_ambient: [Greater Strength] — You set your shoulder to nothing in particular and let the breath out. Nothing here needs moving.
skills.description: Strength enough to shift what was set down to stay put.

skills.field_ambient: [Broader Shoulders] — You square the pack and stand easier under it. There is nothing here worth carrying out.
skills.description: A load that would bow anyone else rides easy on you, and rides all day.

skills.field_ambient: [Bar Fighting] — Your hand goes looking for something with weight to it. This room has nothing to offer.
skills.description: Any common room is full of weapons. The trick is reaching one before the other fellow does.

skills._comment: `repairs` keys the repairs x broken -> state_set row. One-way by substrate: no un-repair row exists.
skills.field_ambient: [Basic Repair] — You look for the break and find none. Whatever is here is already holding.
skills.description: A break put back the way it was meant to sit, and it stays put.

skills._comment: `anchors` keys the anchors x gap -> state_set row. INVENTED NAME (canon [Rope Arrow] is past the spoiler bar): pin the ID, never the bracket string, so a rename stays a one-string diff.
skills.field_ambient: [Rope Work] — You pay out a length and look for something to make it fast to. Nothing here will hold a line.
skills.description: A line made fast at both ends. A gap crossed once stays crossed for whoever comes next.
